descriptionChirho: A lamb or young sheep, a metathesized form of kebes (H3532), used in sacrificial and pastoral contexts. Appears in various morphological forms: absolute singular (Lev 3:7; 17:3; 22:27; Num 18:17), with article (Lev 4:35 the lamb), with conjunctions (Lev 7:23 and a sheep), plural absolute and with article (Gen 30:32-40; Lev 1:10; 22:19; Deut 14:4). All occurrences denote the same animal used as sacrificial offering or livestock. Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm: Arabic hamal/khirfan, German Lamm/Laemmer, Korean eorin yang, Hindi memna/bhed, Spanish cordero/ovejas.
